result.title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
result.summary: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RECON：训练时把预训练视觉编码器 token 注入 diffusion transformer 的后层，推理时用保留下来的 MLP 投影头作为编码器代理继续注入，不增加参数并显著加快收敛。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文「后层难以访问语义」的观察与用投影头代理视觉证据、条件化注入深层状态的做法，可能为 VLM 推理中视觉细节在深层是否保留、以及视觉旁路与表示条件化设计提供可供核查的方法线索；但研究对象是图像生成而非推理状态生成。
